key_concepts.definition: The same progression used in teaching (permission → confidence → competence → mastery) maps directly to the sales sequence. Sell the way you teach.
key_concepts.sales_application: Ask about the kid first, not your service. Relationship-first, not pitch-first.
key_concepts.proven_in: Dung conversion — first message to booked session = one conversation, same day

key_concepts.definition: Every Gospel 444 teaching principle has a mirror as a competitive attack against English centers. Not manufactured positioning — genuine conviction.
attacks: Student interest drives content vs rigid textbooks
Honest progress reporting vs whispered answers
Independence as goal vs dependency for revenue
AI-assisted daily practice vs scheduled sessions only

key_concepts.definition: OBI is not a separate product. OBI is Gospel 444 encoded into software. Carries the teaching method into the 23 hours/day when Michael isn't teaching.
The Dung conversion reveals a sales sequence that IS Gospel 444 applied to selling.
Zero negotiation on price. Value established BEFORE price is mentioned. Maps to Gospel 444: build the experience first, then name the standard.
Phased revenue targets anchored to teaching quality scaling.
Michael's sales DNA is elite. The gap is not conversion — the gap is discovery. Make the accidents happen on purpose.
4-phase scaling from solo teacher to multi-agent content swarm.
phases: Phase 1: Michael 1:1 + OBI daily practice (24-40M VND/mo)
Phase 2-3: Premium 1:1 + OBI self-paced + content agents (multi-track)
Phase 4: Full swarm + course marketplace + B2B licensing (9-figure VND annual)
